title: Position as a discriminant: the (r, z) likelihood ratio between a uniform signal and wall/RFR MSSI at the LZ event, and what LZ left on the table by not using position
question: What is the position likelihood ratio f_sig/f_bkg at (r=45.9 cm, z=26.4 cm) between a uniform-in-FV signal and wall MSSI, RFR MSSI, accidentals, atmospheric neutrinos and neutrons, what Bayes-factor boost does position carry against the full background mixture, and how much would a 3D (S1c, S2c, position) likelihood have moved LZ's 3.4 sigma local / 2.6 sigma global?
headline_result: From an exact vector digitisation of Fig. 3 and P033's photon-transport maps normalised over the real FV, position favours a uniform origin over wall MSSI by 15 (2-50 by gamma source: wall 50, bottom/cathode arrays 2.3) and over 214Pb-RFR MSSI by 17-1500, but over the full background mixture by only 1.8 because accidentals (41%) and CEvNS (9%) are uniform; a 3D likelihood would have given Z_local 3.40 -> 3.57 sigma (+0.09 to +0.19; cap +0.19), global 2.64 -> 2.85 sigma; the event sits at the median wall distance of a uniform signal while the three vetoed >=5 sigma-from-ER events of Fig. S5a sit 2.9-11.3 cm from dead regions (p=0.005)
key_numbers: LR wall MSSI: P033 equal mix 15.1, wall src 49.9, bottom/cathode 2.3/2.4, exp lambda 3/4.3/6 cm 21.7/5.7/2.6, from contour 3.4; RFR: det-gamma map 1.45, 214Pb E2 17/60/1500; neutrons 1.3-1.7; accidentals 1.0 (cathode slab 0.13); b_nb 3.6e-4 (wall 46%, acc 41%, nu 9%), R_pos 0.56, b_eff 6.4e-4, dZ +0.17 (+0.09..+0.19; adverse -0.37), global 2.64->2.85; FV drawn z 9.6-135.8 cm, contour at event depth 58.7-61.2 cm (14.1 cm inside), mass 4.36 (4.22-4.50) t vs 4.71, stand-offs 10.8/7.3 cm reproduced; uniform signal farther from wall 45%; f_pos over real FV 0.021/0.013 (P033 simplified 0.0098/0.0021 reproduced); prompt veto 57/66 within 10 cm of contour, lambda_surface 3.3 cm; S5a crosses 2.9/3.5/11.3 cm, KS p 0.005
model_or_mechanism: single-event extended likelihood with position PDFs: b_eff = sum b_i/LR_i, Z = sqrt(2[ln(1/b_eff)-1+b_eff]) anchored to 3.4 sigma; PDFs from P033 r-z maps re-normalised over the vector-digitised FV, analytic exponentials, E2 plane-sink for 214Pb, KS/binomial population tests
stance: statistical reassessment (strengthens slightly: +0.1-0.2 sigma with position; event position median-typical of a uniform signal)
confidence: medium: exact digitisation and P033 maps validated, but wall-MSSI LR spans 2-50 with the unknown gamma-source mix; 8% FV-mass tension unresolved
